sections.heading: What You Get
sections.intro: A complete website with every page homeowners actually look for — no bloat, no extras you don't need.

items.label: Home page

This is the middle: a productized trade-business website, refined for this field, populated with your business, and launched in about two weeks.

serviceFaq.heading: Common Questions about a Complete Site

faqs.question: How long until a Complete Site is live?
faqs.answer: About two weeks from content handoff to launch. Most delay comes from waiting on photos and a service list — once we have those, the build itself is fast.

faqs.question: What content do I need to provide?
faqs.answer: An owner bio, your services and trades, your service area, license and insurance info, a portrait or jobsite photo, and basic contact info. We give you a checklist on the intro call so nothing is missed.

faqs.question: Do I own the site and the domain?
faqs.answer: You own your content, photos, logo, and domain — your domain stays in your own registrar account. The template system and build infrastructure stay ours, which is how pricing stays simple. If you ever leave, you keep the content and the domain.

faqs.question: How much custom design is in scope?
faqs.answer: Your colors, your photos, your voice, your services — the design system is shaped around your brand. Pixel-by-pixel custom layouts are not in scope (that's a separate one-time build — see the pricing page for current options).

faqs.question: Can I move from an old WordPress site?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. We audit what you have first. On most jobs we rebuild faster than we'd patch — and the new site has none of the WordPress maintenance debt or plugin attack surface.

faqs.question: What if I want changes after launch?
faqs.answer: Email us. Small content changes (new crew member, updated service-area, new before-and-after photos) are handled same-week on Complete and Growth plans — no admin login required.
